notes.title: Don't Kill the Messenger - No Time to Loot Festival
notes.notes: [h1][u]Join The Festival, Join the Fun![/u][/h1][p][/p][p][b]Don't Kill the Messenger [/b]is joining several other wonderful titles as part of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45063983/sale/NoTimeToLootFestival2025"]No Time To Loot Festival[/url] from Sept. 22 - Sept. 29, showcasing games about loot in all its wonderful forms and all the wonderful things that players get to do with it! We're super thankful to HumanQube Games and Sidekick Publishing for this opportunity and hope everyone enjoys the chance to find a few hidden gems that they hadn't found yet during the festival.[/p][p][/p][h1][u]Game Update: Dungeon Flow and Chompers![/u][/h1][p][/p][p]Concurrent with the start of the festival, we've updated the demo of [b]Don't Kill the Messenger[/b] with some significant gameplay updates to improve the flow of play and expand the content that players get to see. Dungeons now operate more akin to a classic Zelda dungeon where rooms lock until all enemies are defeated and then unlock after the task is completed. We've also included a few bug fixes that players had encountered so thank you all for your support in the continued development of the game![/p][p][/p][p]Beyond that, there's a new enemy in this build: the Chomper Plant. It has more health, more damage, and more general snaky hissing vibes than anything you've seen in the build before so we're excited to see how players enjoy dealing with that new challenge.[/p]

notes.title: Live On Kickstarter!
notes.notes: [p]We've been working on Don't Kill the Messenger since January 2025 and are truly proud of the groundwork laid and the demo that we've released thus far. It hasn't been an easy journey and there were several lessons learned along the way (mostly from great feedback from players like you).[/p][p][/p][p]With that said, the project has truly been a self-funded passion of the team and resources need to be managed for the sake of contributors being properly paid for their work. We've just launched a campaign on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2077401188/dont-kill-the-messenger-0"]Kickstarter [/url]to raise funds for that very purpose and hope that we can not only bolster the resources of the project, but also provide some awesome extra value to everyone that participates in the form of truly cool backer rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Those Rewards Include ...[/p][list][*][p]A plush of the main player character (chubby cheeks and all)[/p][/*][*][p]Sticker sheets of in-game character sprites[/p][/*][*][p]An exclusive poster of characters across the game[/p][/*][*][p]Beta access to early builds of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Personalized in-game content[/p][/*][*][p]Other little goodies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]To be clear: Don't Kill the Messenger [b]WILL[/b] release on Steam in the future, but without the help of this kind of external funding the team will need to slow down development for the sake of supporting themselves and their families through other means.[/p][p][/p][p]Kickstarter Page: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2077401188/dont-kill-the-messenger-0"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2077401188/dont-kill-the-messenger-0[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to everyone that has followed and/or participated in the development thus far and we hope that this is just the next step in making this game something truly special for as many people as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595709/7dbb330f4832fd77626ef612ec7ee013ffaf291f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Debut Festival 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]We're super stoked to be included in Debut Festival 2025: a showcase of initial titles for budding developers across the world. 

Don't Kill the Messenger isn't the first game we've ever made, but it is our first game to come to full release on Steam in next year and we hope that all of the games included in the festival get the well deserved attention that they need to find a community they can love.[/p][p][/p][p]We've also got another major announcement coming up in the coming week so stay tuned to hear more about the progress of the game![/p]

notes.title: Don't Kill the Messenger Demo Live NOW!
notes.notes: [p][b]Don't Kill the Messenger[/b] has finally reached a live and playable demo on Steam! [/p][p][/p][p]We've been showcasing the game and gathering feedback at live events, but we're ready to open that opportunity to the Steam community at large![/p][p]Thank you to everyone that has participated so far and an early thanks to everyone that wants to be part of this journey with us. With further feedback and community input we want to make this demo into something truly special that serves as the foundation for a final game that brings joy to as many people as possible.[/p][p]Leave us a review, join the community, and stay tuned for further updates from PolyB Games![/p]

notes.title: DreamHack Updates
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595709/b3fcc1fcbb6cf378ded2d9e1477aac105304d13b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]DreamHack Dallas 2025 was an amazing event and we were proud to be part of it through the Indie Showcase. So many people came by, tried out the game, and gave their feedback about things they loved and things they didn't. [/p][p][/p][p]We've been rapidly working on improvements that are a direct result of the community so we just wanted to say thanks for being part of this with us![/p]

notes.title: Don't Kill the Messenger at DreamHack Dallas
notes.notes:
We've already been showing off the current build of Don't Kill the Messenger at a few live demos and getting some great feedback from players to improve the game!

This week we'll be at DreamHack Dallas to see more players get their hands on the game and show their stuff. Tell your friends and come on over to the Society of Play demo area to see all the cool indie developers showcasing their current projects!
